استكمنت (form X)
# اِسْتَكْمَنْتُ (istakmantu) /is.tak.man.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَكْمَنَ (istakmana)
# اِسْتَكْمَنْتَ (istakmanta) /is.tak.man.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَكْمَنَ (istakmana)
# اِسْتَكْمَنْتِ (istakmanti) /is.tak.man.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَكْمَنَ (istakmana)
# اِسْتَكْمَنَتْ (istakmanat) /is.t
